entities.name: Antoni Leszczewicz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antoni Leszczewicz was a Polish-Belarusian Marian Father and Roman Catholic priest. One of the 108 Martyrs of World War II, he was a missionary in China for two decades in the interwar period, later joining the Congregation of Marian Fathers of the Immaculate Conception before being burnt to death in 1943.
